units.source_text: 因此，说色即是空空即是色，

en.t: Therefore, it is said that form is emptiness and emptiness is form,

units.source_text: 即这样谈论物就是色，谈完之后就是虚空，即空，

en.t: that is, speaking of things in this way is form, and once the speaking is done there is only empty space, that is, emptiness,

units.source_text: 刚觉得空又说物，就像一件精巧细致的手工艺品。

en.t: and just as one thinks of emptiness, one speaks again of things, like a finely crafted and delicate work of handcraft.

units.source_text: 归根到底，人不可能永远属于人，也不可能永远属于虚空。

en.t: In the end, a person cannot belong forever to humanity, nor can a person belong forever to empty space.

units.source_text: 如此看来，无谓之物就是此身。

en.t: Seen in this way, the meaningless thing is this very body.

units.source_text: 不妨稍微考虑一下，究竟虚空是真，还是此身是真。

en.t: One might as well consider for a moment whether empty space is real, or whether this body is real.

units.source_text: 与其先作死后的讨论，莫如想想今夜成眠时此身在何处。

en.t: Rather than first discussing what comes after death, it is better to think about where this body will be when it falls asleep tonight.

units.source_text: 说不定会在何处消失的这个形骸，

en.t: This physical form, which may disappear somewhere without warning,

units.source_text: 还有寻找它的心都整个儿被虚空统统吞没，或是消失得无影无踪。

en.t: and even the mind that searches for it may be swallowed whole by empty space, or vanish without leaving a trace.

units.source_text: 权兵卫八兵卫也不知道在哪儿消失了。

en.t: Even Gonbei and Hachibei have disappeared, no one knows where.
